package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.util;

import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Helpers for the "locality" (region) a pet owner belongs to. The locality is the canonical region
 * looked up from a fixed city-to-region table; a city that is not in the table has the locality
 * {@code "UNKNOWN"}.
 */
public final class Localities {

    /**
     * Fixed city-to-region table. Any city not listed derives the locality {@link #UNKNOWN}.
     */
    private static final Map<String, String> CITY_REGION = Map.of(
        "Sydney", "NSW",
        "Melbourne", "VIC",
        "Brisbane", "QLD");

    /**
     * Locality returned for any city not present in the {@link #CITY_REGION fixed table}.
     */
    public static final String UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN";

    private Localities() {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the canonical region for the given city from the fixed city-to-region table
     * ({@code Sydney -> NSW}, {@code Melbourne -> VIC}, {@code Brisbane -> QLD}), or
     * {@link #UNKNOWN} when the city ({@code null} included) is not in the table.
     *
     * @param city the owner's city
     * @return the canonical region string, or {@code "UNKNOWN"} when the city is not in the table
     */
    public static String region(String city) {
        return CITY_REGION.getOrDefault(city, UNKNOWN);
    }
}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped and the result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            E.164 value (e.g. '+61412345678') is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. The value is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-16'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even if
            another owner already has the same last name and address (i.e. the
            two share a household). Ignored otherwise and never stored.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last names,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot (e.g. 'J.S.').
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A code assigned on create, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is
                a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the
                number of owners at the time of creation (e.g. 'SMI-0007').
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, shared identifier for the owner's household (owners with
                the same last name at the same address). It is derived
                deterministically from the normalized last name and address, so
                every owner in the same household is assigned the same value,
                formatted 'HH-<12 upper-case hex chars>' (e.g. 'HH-3A7F9C2E1B08').
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3A7F9C2E1B08'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating the
                identity-bearing fields into a single value formatted
                '<telephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>' (e.g.
                '+61412345678||HH-3A7F9C2E1B08'). Duplicate detection is expressed
                solely through this key.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3A7F9C2E1B08'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners at the time of creation that share
                this owner's first and last name, compared case-insensitively
                (i.e. excluding this owner itself).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A code derived from the owner's own fields, formatted
                '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate year (e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level derived from their own
                fields, from 1 to 3. Starts at 1; adds 1 when an email is
                present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped at 3 (level 4 is
                reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the time it was created. True once
                that day's owner count exceeds 80, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the optional `postcode` field on owner creation, validated only when present.

**What the rule does:** A 4-digit `postcode` supplied on `POST /api/owners` must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region table (Sydney→NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne→VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane→QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Out-of-range or malformed postcodes are rejected with **400**; an absent postcode is accepted (backward-compatible), and a supplied postcode is stored and returned.

**Changes:**
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the optional `postcode` property to the `OwnerFields` schema, so the generated DTOs carry it on both the create request and the `Owner` response.
- **`model/Owner.java`** — added the `postcode` column, getter, and setter (MapStruct maps it by name in both directions automatically).
- **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added a `postcode` column to the `owners` table.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — added a `validatePostcode(city, postcode)` step (alongside the existing telephone/email/address normalization). It returns `null` when absent/blank, rejects non-4-digit values, and enforces the region range via a fixed `REGION_POSTCODE_RANGES` table, reusing the existing `Localities.region(city)` lookup.
- **`InvalidPostcodeException`** + a handler in **`ExceptionControllerAdvice`** — maps the failure to a 400 with the same `ProblemDetail` shape as the other field validators.

The new `Cp29Tests` (valid stored/returned, absent accepted, malformed rejected) and the postcode-dependent `Cp13Tests` pass, along with all 42 tests.
